definitions.gloss: (of a conversation) to go well; to become lively
definitions.explanation: Of talk between people: to flow easily and grow animated, with everyone joining in and enjoying it. {弾|はず}む is "to bounce"; the talk bounces back and forth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{話|はなし}が{弾|はず}んだ。
examples.english: Talking about old times, the conversation really took off.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{話|はなし}が{弾|はず}んで、{気|き}づいたら⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧たって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Though we'd only just met, we hit it off, and before we knew it three hours had passed.

notes:
Always positive. The topic that set it off takes で: ⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{話|はなし}が{弾|はず}む. ⟦{会話|かいわ}が{弾|はず}む→会話が弾む：15977_kaiwagahazumu⟧ is the same in a slightly more written style.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{会話|かいわ}が{弾|はず}む→会話が弾む：15977_kaiwagahazumu⟧: the conversation flows
- {話|はなし}が{弾|はず}まない: the talk doesn't get going; it's awkward
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧{話|はなし}が{弾|はず}む: the talk livens up once the drinks start

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧: to liven up — of any gathering, not only talk
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to have things in common to talk about
